advisories.text: Basis (3) says "per accepted program". P counts distinct planned programs, but the native vectors that the seeding walks have one entry per retained program, duplicates included. If the unit uses the up-front reserved(n) charge (plan.rs:714-721), the resulting bound is on the raw count n, and n >= P, so it bounds both. The unit should say which count its minimum charge bounds. Not a change to the text. (Clerk's paraphrase of the r5 verdict.)
